forum.title: STM32U5G9ZJT6Q Footprint Confirmation
forum.best_answer_content: LQFP144 is missing from the datasheet, but it will be physically identical to any other STM32 LQFP144 mechanical dimensions. Using the H5 sheet for those is fine.
forum.content_text:
Hi Team,

I'm recently using the STM32U5G9ZJT6Q part in one of my design. I couldn't find the package mechanical information in Datasheet. For now, I'm using the LQFP-144 form the STM32H573ZIT3Q part number. Will it be okay? Can you please help to verify it?

Attaching the below Screenshots,

Screenshot from the STM32U5 Datasheet. Not having the LQFP-144 details.

Screenshot from the STM32H5 Datasheet. Having the LQFP-144 details
forum.author: Ayyanar_Raja

scraped_replies.html: LQFP144 is missing from the datasheet, but it will be physically identical to any other STM32 LQFP144 mechanical dimensions. Using the H5 sheet for those is fine.
scraped_replies.author: TDK

scraped_replies.html: Hi, It would be better if details added in Datasheet.
scraped_replies.author: Ayyanar_Raja

scraped_replies.html: I think we would all agree, this information should be in the Datasheet.
